17:105.text: And with the truth We have sent it
down, and with the truth it has descended. And We have not sent you,
, except as a bringer of good tidings and a warner.

17:106.text: a Qur’ān which We have separated
that you might recite it to the people over a prolonged period. And We have sent it down progressively.

17:107.text: Say, "Believe in it or do not believe." Indeed, those who were given knowledge before it
- when it is recited to them, they fall upon their faces in prostration,

17:108.text: And they say, "Exalted is our Lord! Indeed, the promise of our Lord has been fulfilled."
